config.notes: ULethbridge programme pages are www.ulethbridge.ca/future-student/program/<subject> (undergraduate, one page per subject covering BA, BA&Sc, combined degrees) and /future-student/graduate-studies/<programme>. Both print a labelled block: Credentials available / Campus (Lethbridge, Calgary) / Intake (e.g. "Fall & Winter", "Fall", "Summer"). Term months from the university academic schedule (https://www.ulethbridge.ca/sites/ross/files/imported/academic-schedule/Academic-Schedule.pdf; https://www.ulethbridge.ca/ross/admissions/grad/deadlines): Fall = September, Winter = January. Summer is deliberately NOT mapped: the Summer term opens in May but Summer-intake graduate programmes (e.g. PhD in Education) start on campus in July, so a Summer intake gives no month. Pages carry NO fee and NO IELTS: international tuition is central (https://www.ulethbridge.ca/future-student/undergraduate-tuition-fees, 2026/27 CAD 24,662.20 per year full-time) and English is central (https://www.ulethbridge.ca/ross/admissions/elp and /ross/admissions/grad/elr: IELTS 6.5 overall, 6.0 each band). /ross/post-diploma/eligible/N pages are diploma-transfer tables, not programme pages; "(program suspended)" in their titles is read as not_admitting. Catalogue course codes are ALIS programme ids, not printed on pages. Most courses are bound to the wrong pages (old PDF planning guides, department, careers, news pages): rebinding undergraduate courses to /future-student/program/<subject> is the fix.
